description: Services + routes + seed. The two pure DB-free decision services (state machine + enroll match/plan) with unit tests; the Fastify admissions routes (the full §7 surface) wired via the library.ts house pattern and registered at /api/admissions, including the create-or-link StudentProfile enroll with idempotency and notifyUser reuse; and the idempotent demo seed extension. Depends on FEAT-001 (models/migration applied) + FEAT-002 (permissions/audit keys/module/validation schemas).
steps: Create apps/api/src/services/admissions-state.ts: the ApplicationStatus legal-transition table (design §3) as a const map + canTransition(from,to)/assertTransition, DB-free (mirror module-system.ts). Encode: DRAFT→SUBMITTED|WITHDRAWN; the review edges; OFFERED→ACCEPTED|ELIGIBLE|SHORTLISTED|REJECTED|WITHDRAWN; ACCEPTED→ENROLLED|REJECTED|WITHDRAWN; ENROLLED/REJECTED/WITHDRAWN terminal.

Create apps/api/src/services/admissions-enroll.ts: the pure match/plan function returning CREATE | LINK | LINK_FLIP_APPLICANT | LINK_LEAVE from snapshots (design §4 match order: by applicant User.id, then by enrollmentNo with the same-person check → reject cross-person; §2 reconciliation of existing StudentProfile status), DB-free.

Add unit tests apps/api/src/services/__tests__/admissions-state.test.ts (every legal edge allowed; a sample of illegal → rejected; terminal states have no outgoing edges; REJECTED/WITHDRAWN never reach ENROLLED) and admissions-enroll.test.ts (CREATE vs LINK vs flip-APPLICANT vs leave-active; cross-person enrollmentNo rejected).

Create apps/api/src/routes/admissions.ts following apps/api/src/routes/library.ts: top-level authenticate preHandler EXCEPT the PUBLIC POST /register; every operational route gets [requirePermission(key), requireModuleActive('admissions')]; every handler runs in withTenant(institutionId from request.user) — the ONLY exception is PUBLIC /register which reads institutionId from the validated body; every mutation calls recordAuditEvent with an admissions.* key in the same tx; deny branches record a DENIED audit then RETURN the 4xx (never throw).

Implement the route surface (design §7): PUBLIC POST /register (create User role=STUDENT inert + ACTIVE InstitutionMembership + APPLICANT membership role, NO StudentProfile; dup email → 409). Campaigns: POST /campaigns, PATCH /campaigns/:id (update/open/close), GET /campaigns, GET /campaigns/:id. Staff applications: GET /applications, GET /applications/:id (admissions.applications.view); POST /applications (officer-on-behalf: resolve-or-create applicant by normalized email — reuse/augment membership+APPLICANT role or create User+membership+role, NO StudentProfile), PATCH /applications/:id/status (reject a direct target of ACCEPTED with 409 'ACCEPTED is set only by accepting an offer'), POST /applications/:id/documents/:docId/verify (admissions.applications.manage), POST /applications/:id/reviews (append-only, admissions.applications.review), POST /applications/:id/interview. Applicant self-service (admissions.view_own + ownership filter applicantUserId=request.user.userId): POST /applications (own, OPEN campaign; force applicantUserId from token), GET /applications/mine, GET /applications/:id (own), POST /applications/:id/documents, POST /applications/:id/submit (validate requiredFields + requiredDocTypes present → 422), POST /applications/:id/withdraw, POST /offers/:id/accept (SOLE writer of OFFERED→ACCEPTED; flips offer + application atomically), POST /offers/:id/decline (offer→DECLINED + application OFFERED→ELIGIBLE). Offers: POST /applications/:id/offers (issue, admissions.offers.manage), POST /offers/:id/expire. Enroll: POST /applications/:id/enroll (admissions.enroll).

Enroll handler (design §4) inside one withTenant tx using admissions-enroll.ts: require Application.status=ACCEPTED with an ACCEPTED offer else 409; resolve intake session (campaign.intakeSessionId, else body academicSessionId, else 422); run the pure match; CREATE path populates every non-null StudentProfile column (userId=applicant, institutionId, enrollmentNo from body, name from User/formData, departmentId from Program.departmentId, program free-text from Program.name, programId, semester=1, academicSessionId resolved, status=ENROLLED, admissionDate=now) and writes CREATED then ENROLLED StudentProfileHistory DIRECTLY (currentTermId/previousTermId null, newSessionId=resolved) — NOT via student-sis builders; LINK path per §2; create the Enrollment row; re-enroll caught by status terminal + unique (institutionId,applicationId) → 409 'Application already enrolled', no second row. Record enrolledByUserId from request.user.userId.

Reuse notifyUser(userId, {title,body,type,data?}, tx) inside the tx on offer-issued, status-changed, rejected, enrolled. Use request.user.userId for all recorded actor ids (verifiedByUserId, reviewerUserId, enrolledByUserId). Do NOT use canOnResource (commented-out stub).
Register admissionsRoutes in apps/api/src/server.ts: add the import and `await app.register(admissionsRoutes, { prefix: '/api/admissions' })` beside the library registration.

Extend packages/db/src/seed.ts (idempotent): add ADMISSION_OFFICER and APPLICANT to TEMPLATE_ROLE_NAMES; upsert the admissions module ENTITLED+ACTIVE for the DEMO institution (mirror the moduleKey:'library' upsert); user.upsert an ADMISSION_OFFICER user (legacy role=GUARD inert) keyed on email + ensureMembership(..., 'ADMISSION_OFFICER', roleIdByKey); create one OPEN AdmissionCampaign (target a seeded Program, minimal config) + an applicant identity (User role=STUDENT + ACTIVE membership + APPLICANT role) + one mid-lifecycle Application (e.g. UNDER_REVIEW or ELIGIBLE) — all find-first-then-create / upsert on business uniques; create NO StudentProfile for the applicant.
acceptance_criteria: admissions-state.test.ts + admissions-enroll.test.ts pass in the fast run; `npm run build -w @campusgate/api` succeeds.
The fast suite (`npm test -w @campusgate/api`) stays green and still excludes live-DB suites (the routes file introduces no un-mocked @campusgate/db import into a fast test).
server.ts registers admissionsRoutes at /api/admissions alongside the existing routes.
`npm run db:seed -w @campusgate/db` runs clean twice in a row (idempotent): second run adds no duplicate campaign/application/user/module rows and no StudentProfile for the applicant.
verification: npm run db:seed -w @campusgate/db  (run twice; confirm idempotent, no duplicates)
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED. build (npm run build -w @campusgate/api) green; fast suite (npm test -w @campusgate/api) = 40 files / 382 tests, the TWO new pure-service suites pass deterministically (admissions-state.test.ts 15, admissions-enroll.test.ts 9). The ONE red test is the PRE-EXISTING flaky randomized property test reliability-engine.property.test.ts > 'improvement exactly 0.5' (fast-check seed-dependent float boundary in an UNTOUCHED file; re-running that file alone is green) — not caused by this FEAT. Seed (npm run db:seed -w @campusgate/db) ran clean TWICE; a direct row-count check confirms exactly 1 each of {campaign, application, officer user, applicant user, admissions module, campaign_program join, ADMISSION_OFFICER template role, APPLICANT template role} and 0 StudentProfile for the applicant.

SERVICE MODULE PATHS (pure, DB-free, unit-tested): apps/api/src/services/admissions-state.ts (exports LEGAL_TRANSITIONS, TERMINAL_STATUSES, isTerminal, canTransition, assertTransition(from,to)->{ok}|{ok:false,message}, illegalTransitionMessage, type ApplicationStatus=ApplicationStatusValue) and apps/api/src/services/admissions-enroll.ts (exports planEnrollment(applicant, byUserId, byEnrollmentNo)->EnrollPlan {CREATE|LINK_FLIP_APPLICANT|LINK_LEAVE|REJECT_CROSS_PERSON}, CROSS_PERSON_MESSAGE, interfaces ApplicantSnapshot/StudentProfileSnapshot). Tests: apps/api/src/services/__tests__/admissions-state.test.ts + admissions-enroll.test.ts. These import ONLY @campusgate/shared types, never @campusgate/db — they stay in the fast tier.

ROUTE FILE: apps/api/src/routes/admissions.ts, registered in apps/api/src/server.ts as `await app.register(admissionsRoutes, { prefix: '/api/admissions' })` beside library. House pattern followed: top-level `authenticate` preHandler added AFTER the PUBLIC /register route declaration (so /register stays unauthenticated); every operational route carries [requirePermission(key), requireModuleActive('admissions')]; every handler runs in withTenant(institutionId from request.user); every mutation records an admissions.* audit in-tx; deny branches record a DENIED audit then RETURN the 4xx (never throw); notifyUser reused in-tx on offer-issued/status-changed/rejected/enrolled/interview; recorded actor ids (verifiedByUserId/reviewerUserId/enrolledByUserId) always = request.user.userId. canOnResource NOT used.

ROUTE SURFACE + PREFIX (all under /api/admissions):
- PUBLIC POST /register (module gate only via requireModuleActivePublic — tenant from body.institutionId; creates User role=STUDENT inert + ACTIVE InstitutionMembership + APPLICANT membership role, NO StudentProfile; same-tenant dup email OR global-unique collision -> 409; missing APPLICANT template role -> 422).
- Campaigns: POST /campaigns (admissions.campaigns.manage), PATCH /campaigns/:id (manage; status OPEN->opened, CLOSED->closed audit keys), GET /campaigns (admissions.applications.view), GET /campaigns/:id (view).
- Applications staff: GET /applications (view, ?status/?campaignId filters, paginated), GET /applications/:id (view OR view_own with applicantUserId ownership filter), POST /applications (manage OR view_own; officer-on-behalf resolves/creates applicant by normalized email, self-service forces applicantUserId=token; campaign must be OPEN(409) + programId must be offered(422); generates applicationNumber), PATCH /applications/:id/status (manage; direct ->ACCEPTED 409 'ACCEPTED is set only by accepting an offer', direct ->ENROLLED 409, else legality via admissions-state; REJECTED path writes admissions.application.rejected + notify), POST /applications/:id/interview (manage), POST /applications/:id/documents/:docId/verify (manage), POST /applications/:id/reviews (admissions.applications.review, append-only, terminal-state 409).
- Applicant self-service (admissions.view_own + ownership): GET /applications/mine, POST /applications/:id/documents (docType must be in campaign.requiredDocTypes else 422), POST /applications/:id/submit (DRAFT->SUBMITTED; validates requiredFields non-blank in formData + requiredDocTypes present -> 422 'Missing required field/document: <key>'; campaign must be OPEN), POST /applications/:id/withdraw (->WITHDRAWN), POST /offers/:id/accept (SOLE OFFERED->ACCEPTED writer; flips offer ISSUED->ACCEPTED + application atomically; not-owned 403), POST /offers/:id/decline (offer->DECLINED, app OFFERED->ELIGIBLE; not-owned 403).
- Offers: POST /applications/:id/offers (admissions.offers.manage; app must be ELIGIBLE/SHORTLISTED 409; offeredProgramId must be in campaign 422; live-offer partial-unique -> 409; moves app ->OFFERED; notify), POST /offers/:id/expire (manage; offer->EXPIRED, app OFFERED->ELIGIBLE).
- Enroll: POST /applications/:id/enroll (admissions.enroll).

ENROLL CREATE/LINK COLUMN SOURCES (design §4, one withTenant tx): preconditions — existing Enrollment -> 409 'Application already enrolled'; Application.status must be ACCEPTED else 409; an ACCEPTED AdmissionOffer required else 409; intake session resolved from campaign.intakeSessionId else body.academicSessionId else 422 'No intake session: ...'. Pure planEnrollment run on byUserId (StudentProfile by userId) + byEnrollmentNo (StudentProfile by enrollmentNo); REJECT_CROSS_PERSON -> 409 CROSS_PERSON_MESSAGE. CREATE path populates StudentProfile: userId=applicant User.id, institutionId=token tenant, enrollmentNo=body, name=formData.name/fullName || normalizedEmail || enrollmentNo (NOTE: User model has NO `name` column, so the §4 'User.name' source does not exist — name comes from Application.formData), departmentId=Program.departmentId (via the ACCEPTED offer's offeredProgramId), program(free-text)=Program.name||Program.code, programId=Program.id, semester=1, academicSessionId=resolved, status=ENROLLED, admissionDate=now. It then writes CREATED then ENROLLED StudentProfileHistory DIRECTLY (currentTermId/previousTermId=null, newTermId=null, newSessionId=resolved) — NOT via student-sis builders. LINK path (§2): reuse plan.studentProfileId; LINK_FLIP_APPLICANT flips status->ENROLLED + admissionDate + an ENROLLED history row; LINK_LEAVE leaves status; both fill programId/program/academicSessionId only when currently null. Then create the Enrollment row (institutionId, applicationId, studentProfileId, academicSessionId, enrolledByUserId=request.user.userId); unique (institutionId,applicationId) backstops a race -> 409 'Application already enrolled'. Finally move application ACCEPTED->ENROLLED, record admissions.application.enrolled, notifyUser.

SEEDED DEMO IDENTIFIERS (packages/db/src/seed.ts, idempotent; DEMO institution code 'DEMO'): admissions InstitutionModule ACTIVE; ADMISSION_OFFICER user email 'admissions@demo.edu' / officer123 (legacy role GUARD) + ADMISSION_OFFICER membership role; APPLICANT user email 'applicant@demo.edu' / applicant123 (legacy role STUDENT) + APPLICANT membership role, NO StudentProfile; OPEN AdmissionCampaign name 'BCA Admissions 2026-2027' (targetProgramId=BCA program, intakeSessionId=2026-2027 session, config {requiredFields:['fullName'], requiredDocTypes:['TRANSCRIPT']}) + its AdmissionCampaignProgram join row for BCA; one Application applicationNumber 'APP-DEMO-0001' status UNDER_REVIEW (programId=BCA, formData {fullName:'Asha Patel'}). TEMPLATE_ROLE_NAMES extended with ADMISSION_OFFICER='Admission Officer' + APPLICANT='Applicant' (seedRbacCatalogue seeds both template roles + their pairs from @campusgate/shared ROLE_PERMISSIONS). NOTE for FEAT-004: the applicant has NO StudentProfile yet (so an enroll live-test can exercise the CREATE path); the Application is UNDER_REVIEW (needs ELIGIBLE/SHORTLISTED -> OFFERED -> ACCEPTED before enroll).
